metadata.title: Merchant Commerce Platform Data Assets
metadata.description: Logical data assets of a merchant commerce platform with governance for merchant, shopper, payment and AI data. Legal tags reflect obligations typical for platforms processing card payments and consumer data in the EU and North America; exact obligations depend on jurisdiction and licensing.

rootGroups.name: Merchant, Account and Ecosystem Data
rootGroups.description: Who the merchant is, who works for them and which apps can act for them.

subGroups.name: Accounts and Access
subGroups.description: Shops, organizations, staff and app grants.

governance.retention: life of account plus statutory period
